Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Crockpot Mongolian Beef & Noodles 🥩🍜🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 7: Mongolian Beef & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. Tender chuck roast, a sweet and savory Mongolian-style sauce, and noodles coated in all that flavor. We sear the beef for extra color, then the crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced chuck roast 4 tablespoons butter, for searing 1 cup low-sodium shoyu 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup low-sodium beef broth 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon grated ginger 2 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons cold water 12 ounces precooked lo mein noodles. I used yakisoba noodles brand is Fortune. Sliced green onions Sesame seeds, optional Instructions: 1. Season your beef with SPG or your favorite seasoning. Heat a skillet over high heat with the butter and sear the beef in small batches for 1-2 minutes per side. You’re building color, not cooking it through. 2. Transfer the beef to the crockpot. Deglaze the skillet with a splash of the measured beef broth, scrape up those browned bits, and pour everything into the crockpot. 3. Add the remaining broth, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper. Stir gently. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2.5 to 3.5 hours. Start checking early so the thin beef stays tender without falling apart. 5. Mix the cornstarch slurry with a cup of broth. Stir the slurry into the sauce and cook on HIGH for 15–20 minutes, until thick and glossy. 6. Slice the green onions into 1 inch piece. Separate the precooked noodles and add them directly to the crockpot. Toss everything together and heat on HIGH for 5–10 minutes. 7. Finish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds, and chili crisp oil if you want some heat then serve immediately. Don’t leave those noodles sitting on KEEP WARM—they’ll keep drinking up the sauce. Save this one for an easy weeknight dinner! 🍜🔥 #crockpotrecipes #crockpot #EasyRecipe #hawaiitiktok #mongolianbeef

Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. Honey Garlic Herb Lamb Chops Ingredients 1. Frenched lamb chops – 12 pieces 2. Olive oil – 3 tbsp 3. Unsalted butter – 3 tbsp 4. Garlic – 6 cloves, minced 5. Fresh rosemary – 2 tbsp, finely chopped 6. Fresh thyme – 1 tbsp, chopped 7. Honey – 3 tbsp 8. Soy sauce – 2 tbsp 9. Dijon mustard – 1 tbsp 10. Lemon juice – 1 tbsp 11. Smoked paprika – 1 tsp 12. Black pepper – 1 tsp 13. Kosher salt – 1 tsp 14. Beef or lamb broth – 1/2 cup 15. Fresh parsley – 2 tbsp, chopped Recipe 1. Pat the lamb chops thoroughly dry with paper towels so the surface can develop a deep golden-brown crust during cooking. 2. In a bowl, combine the olive oil, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Rub the herb mixture generously over both sides of every lamb chop. 3. Cover the seasoned lamb chops and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours, allowing the herbs and garlic to penetrate the meat. 4. Remove the lamb from the refrigerator 20 minutes before cooking so it can lose some of its chill and cook more evenly. 5. Preheat the oven to 400°F and heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add the butter and allow it to melt and become lightly foamy. 6. Arrange the lamb chops in the hot skillet without overcrowding them. Sear for 2 to 3 minutes per side until a dark, caramelized crust forms. 7. Mix the honey, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, and lamb or beef broth in a small bowl until smooth. 8. Pour the honey-garlic sauce around the lamb chops and spoon some of it over the tops. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven. 9. Roast the lamb for 5 to 8 minutes, depending on thickness and desired doneness, until the meat reaches the preferred internal temperature. 10. Remove the skillet from the oven and baste the lamb repeatedly with the hot buttery sauce, allowing the glaze to coat the browned crust. 11. Let the lamb chops rest in the skillet for 5 minutes so the juices redistribute while the sauce thickens slightly. 12. Arrange the lamb chops on a large serving platter and drizzle the remaining honey-herb sauce over the top. 13. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley and a few additional rosemary and thyme sprigs for a finished presentation. 14. Serve immediately with warm dinner rolls, roasted potatoes, vegetables, or a fresh green salad alongside the glazed lamb chops. Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. My wife pregnant wife was craving burgers 🍔 for dinner so I made her:  Double Gouda Burgers with Garlic Parmesan Dipping Sauce ♥️ Ingredients For the burgers: * 700 g ground beef (about 1.54 lb) * Gouda cheese, sliced * Salt and pepper * Burger buns * Lettuce * Caramelized onions For the garlic Parmesan dipping sauce: * 1 tablespoon butter * 5–6 garlic cloves, finely chopped * 200 ml heavy cream (¾ cup plus 1 tablespoon) * 100 ml milk (⅓ cup plus 1 tablespoon) * 60 g grated Parmesan (about ½–⅔ cup) * 1 tablespoon seasoning blend made with paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder * Salt and pepper, to taste * A small amount of chopped parsley For the burger sauce: * 3 tablespoons mayonnaise * 1 tablespoon mustard * Chopped pickles * Salt and pepper, to taste Instructions Step 1 – Prepare the burgers: Shape the ground beef into patties and season both sides with salt and pepper. Cook in a hot skillet until browned and cooked to your liking. Place Gouda on each patty, allow it to melt, and stack two patties together. Step 2 – Mix the burger sauce: Combine the mayonnaise, mustard, chopped pickles, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Mix until creamy, then set aside. Step 3 – Sauté the garlic: Using the same skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the chopped garlic and cook for one to two minutes, just until fragrant. Keep an eye on it so the garlic doesn’t burn. Step 4 – Start the dipping sauce: Pour in the heavy cream and milk. Add the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Stir everything together and let it gently simmer until it begins to thicken. Step 5 – Finish the sauce: Add the Parmesan and stir until completely melted and smooth. Mix in the chopped parsley. The sauce should be thick and creamy but still pourable—flowing from the spoon almost like a small fountain. Step 6 – Toast the buns: Place the burger buns cut-side down in a pan and toast until golden brown and slightly crispy. Step 7 – Assemble the burgers: Spread the burger sauce on the bun, followed by the lettuce, double Gouda patties, and caramelized onions. Add the top bun, cut the burger in half, and serve with the garlic Parmesan sauce for dipping.

My husband approves.                     Lazy one-pot chicken pot pie 🥧 No bottom crust, no fuss—just a cozy supper with home-canned chicken and a golden crust on top. You’ll need * 1 quart home-canned chicken with its broth     (or 2 cans of chicken or pulled rotisserie chicken) * 3 carrots, peeled and diced * 1 medium onion, diced * 3 medium Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and diced * Avocado oil * About 3 cups water * 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon * Garlic, Gator Dust or Cajun seasoning, salt and pepper, to taste * 1½ cups milk, plus ¼ cup cold milk for the slurry * 2 tablespoons cornstarch * 1 or 2 store-bought pie crusts, depending on your pan How I make it 1. Heat the oven to 400°F. In a heavy-bottomed, oven-safe pan, sauté the carrots, onion, and potatoes in avocado oil until they begin to soften. 2. Add the water, bouillon, garlic, and seasonings. Simmer for 10–15 minutes, until the carrots start to soften. 3. Add the chicken and its broth. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Stir in the 1½ cups milk and simmer gently for another 5–10 minutes. 4. Turn off the heat. Mix the cornstarch with the remaining ¼ cup cold milk, then stir it into the pot. Keep stirring while the residual heat thickens the filling. Taste and season once more. 5. Drape the pie crust over the top—no bottom crust needed. Cut a few slits, drizzle with olive oil, and add a little seasoning. 6. Cover with the pan’s lid and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the lid and bake until golden, about 15 minutes more. That’s supper, y’all. 🤎 #Chicken #chickenpotpie #easysupper

INGREDIENTS: • 2 lbs ground beef • 1 lb penne or rotini pasta • 1 small onion, diced • 1 tbsp minced garlic • 2 tbsp butter • 2 cups heavy whipping cream • 1 cup beef broth • 1–1½ cups grated Parmesan cheese • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce • Parsley, optional SEASONINGS: • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp black pepper INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook your pasta until al dente. Before draining, reserve about 1 cup of pasta water. 2. Add your ground beef and diced onion to a large skillet or wok. Cook until the beef is browned and the onions are tender. Drain any excess grease if needed. 3. Add the seasoned salt, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper, minced garlic, and Worcestershire sauce. Mix everything together and let it cook for about a minute. 4. Add the butter and stir until completely melted into the seasoned beef. 5. Pour in the heavy whipping cream and beef broth. Stir everything together and bring it to a gentle simmer. 6. Turn the heat down and gradually add the Parmesan cheese, stirring until completely melted and the sauce becomes thick and creamy. 7. Add your cooked pasta directly into the skillet and toss until every piece is covered in that creamy garlic Parmesan beef sauce. 8. If your sauce gets too thick, add a little reserved pasta water until you get the consistency you want. 9.
